asynchronous_ingress_separation_architec.core_principle: Preserve existing WukongIM-to-MySQL asynchronous webhook synchronization unchanged (no synchronous send-time trigger-row insert, no WukongIM changes, and no retry-budget-only substitute). Separate (1) current live ingress admission, tool revalidation, and ordinary reply authorization from (2) stored message/resource operations (actual history reads, explicit quote/reply-to message lookup, historical contributors, and stored message edits/deletes).

bind_live_ingress.behavior: Evaluates live current principal, space, DM friend/blacklist, group/thread membership, status, join-time/clear-history channel_offset, and channel_setting cutoffs under the caller's RepeatableRead SQL transaction and FencedAuthority cut without requiring the trigger message row in MySQL. Canonicalizes bare-peer DM channel_id via PairReference(key.BotUID, req.ChannelID). Mints l1-... delivery_reference and l2-... header_reference with native_message_version='live_unpersisted_v1', provenance='live_channel_acl_v1', trigger_row_persisted=bool, and content_attested_by_server=bool.
bind_live_ingress.unpersisted_honesty_invariant: When the trigger message row is not yet present in MySQL message{N}, trigger_row_persisted=false, content_attested_by_server=false, and resolvable_purposes=['admit','reply']. Server never claims to have attested stored message body bytes it has not observed in storage.
bind_live_ingress.persisted_cross_check_invariant: If the trigger message row is already present in MySQL (or arrives asynchronously mid-turn), Server cross-checks message.is_deleted, expire TTL, message_extra.revoke/is_deleted/content_edit, from_uid, message_seq, payload SHA-256, payload space_id tag, payload visibles whitelist, and message_user_extra per-user deletion, failing closed on any conflict (expired_reference, identity_mismatch, payload_digest_mismatch, visibility_denied) while keeping header_reference='l2-...' and native_message_version='live_unpersisted_v1' invariant across mid-turn rechecks.

resolve_with_l1_token.behavior: Accepts l1-... live delivery references for purpose='admit' and purpose='reply' and evaluates the exact 10 predicate profiles in shared-contract-v6.json without requiring the trigger message row in MySQL. Refuses purpose='contributor' on unpersisted l1-... tokens with status='unavailable', reason='mirror_lag'.

evaluate_current_access.behavior: Stateless current-ACL evaluation for purpose='admit' or 'reply' returning status='evaluated'|'unavailable', eligible=bool, profile, provenance='live_channel_acl_v1', trigger_row_persisted=bool, content_attested_by_server=bool, native_message_version, source, parent_group, caller_uid, author_kind, authority_refs, and predicates.

stored_message_operations_remain_strict.bind_delivery: Continues to require a persisted MySQL message{N} row and returns status='refused', reason='mirror_lag' when the row is absent.
stored_message_operations_remain_strict.s1_h1_c1_references: All s1-... delivery references, h1-... header references, c1-... history source references, history_headers, and history_disclosure continue to require persisted MySQL message rows.
stored_message_operations_remain_strict.history_disclosure_rejects_live_tokens: Passing an l2-... (or l1-...) live token to history_disclosure returns status='unavailable', reason='predicate_unsupported' and never issues a history disclosure permit without a stored MySQL message row.

single_writer_concurrency_serialization.fix: FencedAuthorityAdapter serializes active scopeTx transactions via a context-aware transaction gate acquired in Store.begin before session.BeginTx and released in scopeTx.close after complete() / RollbackUnlessCommitted(), and NativeSingleWriterLineageDriver.readSQLRow only appends FOR UPDATE NOWAIT when forUpdate=true (RecoverAtLeast), preventing MVCC snapshot vs hostState position inversion and InnoDB singleton=1 lock contention across concurrent requests.
